claim.title: Add a bot
claim.intro: Type the bot's Application ID. Three conditions:
claim.conditionDiscoverable: the bot is discoverable: the developer turns it on in the Developer Portal, App Directory section;
claim.conditionSupport: it has a support server (the Support Server field of the portal);
claim.conditionAdmin: you own or administer that support server. "Manage Server" is not enough.
claim.idHint: The id is in the Discord Developer Portal, General Information, Application ID.
claim.idInvalid: An Application ID is made of digits only (17 to 20).
claim.claimed: This bot already has a profile.
claim.notAdmin: You must be an administrator of {{name}} to claim this bot.
claim.notAdminHelp: If you just got these rights, wait a few minutes: the list of your servers is kept for 5 minutes.
